summary: Hardened `/tmp` and `/dev/shm` on node1 with persistent tmpfs mounts using `nosuid,nodev,noexec`. Reboot verification passed.
actions_performed: Added explicit `/etc/fstab` entries for both mounts with mode 1777.
Activated and validated the hardened mounts.
Verified execution and device-node access are blocked.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed persistence and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Both mounts ignore execution, setuid bits, and device nodes, with persistent configuration
evidence.summary: Live VFS options show `nosuid,nodev,noexec`; fstab validation passed. Execution returned 126 and device-node access was denied on both mounts.
After reboot, both tmpfs mounts retained the required options, remained writable with mode 1777, and persistent configuration validated successfully.

Healthy baseline boot ID was f38484ef-a289-4d30-9a94-4ab42c44f900; reboot was acknowledged; new boot ID d65d52e4-a6fe-43a4-9cd2-1b6122f553a6 proves restart; system returned to running state with both mounts healthy.
